sheets.title: Dream things (the moth seen from the side, facing right)

note: w6 Dream Meadow by image to 3D. Pictures 1 to 3 landmarks (--grid 1x1); 4 is a 2x2 sheet with one empty quarter. Everything else Dream Meadow places comes from the other worlds' docs. Cut with sheetcut.py --tol 18 --holes 8 (grey things at --tol 10 --holes 0).

doc.blurb: a calm dreamy meadow where everything from the other worlds drifts together
doc.style: soft handmade toys of smooth matte felt with neat stitched seams and gently rounded forms, no fuzz, in calm pastels (lavender, moon white, pale blue, soft pink and mint) with a faint glow, soft even light from the upper left, clean simple shapes.
